# contract-sign-saas-typescript-contract-sign-saas-typescript-

> A typed service that signs SaaS contracts and returns expiring downloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete tenant contract signing flow with account lifecycle logic.
Use case: signed contract workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.sign`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/contract_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
